summary: A phone's fabric grant is inbound-only (fabric 0.2.41 or later): the docs, setup instructions and the isolated proof helpers grant it with fabric add --inbound-only, so a member serves the phone when it connects and never dials, probes or announces to it, and the bridge's pinned-daemon test proves the member probes an ordinary peer but never the phone

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. The phone's grant is a member-side fabric peers.toml entry, not st state.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change. The grant is the same exact single-service grant; inbound-only only stops the member dialling, probing and announcing to the phone, and st still checks pairing and scopes after fabric admits the stream.

compatibility.detail: The documented grant and the isolated proof helper (apps/ios/modules/st-fabric/proof-member.mjs) now use fabric add --inbound-only, which needs fabric 0.2.41 or later; the helper and the bridge's ignored pinned-daemon test expect 0.2.41+84c3208 by default and the helper rejects the earlier 0.2.30 and 0.2.32 pins. The app, the bridge, its wire and existing member grants are unchanged: an existing ordinary grant keeps admitting the phone, and an old app keeps working against the same members.

downtime.detail: No running service changes; nothing is staged on any member.

manual.detail: No action is required. An operator who wants a member to stop probing an already granted phone re-adds it with fabric add PHONE_NODE_ID NAME --inbound-only --allow SERVICE on fabric 0.2.41 or later.

recovery.detail: Removing the phone's peer entry and reloading undoes an inbound-only grant, as it does an ordinary one.
